method: Each public skill was read in full by an AI reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5) and scored 1-10 on three axes against a fixed rubric with calibration anchors (median around 6-7; 9+ is rare). Scores are a reviewer's judgement, not a guarantee; they are refreshed when skills change.

axes.quality: Correctness and craft: right and current commands, numbers and standards; clear, no filler.
axes.depth: Professional detail: real parameters, thresholds, standards, failure modes and a real-order workflow.
axes.practical: Real-life use by an AI agent: can it be applied end to end and checked, with tools an agent can drive.
